author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Enhanced Update Release Date Trailer for Conan Exiles, an online multiplayer survival game developed by Funcom. Players can soon gain access to a free visual update coming to the game on Steam that's packed with features delivered in the rebuild of the game to Unreal Engine 5. Enjoy improved visuals, enhanced performance, modern rendering technology, and more with the upcoming visual upgrade. The Enhanced Update for Conan Exiles is launching on May 5 for PC (Steam), with the game being available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

title: Conan Exiles - Official Enhanced Update Release Date Trailer

description:
Take a look at the color trailer for Spider-Noir, an upcoming live-action superhero series distributed by Amazon Prime Video. Explore the story of Ben Reilly portrayed by Nicolas Cage in Spider-Noir, premiering worldwide on May 27 exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.

Spider-Noir tells the story of Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, who is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city’s one and only superhero.

Spider-Noir stars Nicolas Cage, Lamorne Morris, Li Jun Li, Karen Rodriguez, Abraham Popoola, Jack Huston, Brendan Gleeson, and more. Guest stars such as Lukas Haas, Cameron Britton, Cary Christopher, Michael Kostroff, Scott MacArthur, Joe Massingill, Whitney Rice, Amanda Schull, Andrew Caldwell, Amy Aquino, Andrew Robinson, and Kai Caster are also featured in the series.

author: IGN
description:
Pokémon turns 30 in 2026, but not everything about the world's biggest media franchise is cute and cuddly. From mass seizures in Japan to Burger King’s toy recall after a child’s death, banned episodes, swastikas on trading cards, and Pokémon GO becoming such a sensation that it became a talking point during a US presidential election, the history of Pokémon overlaps with some very strange corners of real life. We're breaking down some of the most notable controversies, debacles, incidents, snafus and hubbubs from Pokémon's 30-year history (the ones Nintendo doesn't want you to remember.)

CHAPTERS
00:00 – Introduction
01:20 – Pokémon Shock (1997): The Episode That Sent 685 Kids to the Hospital
04:30 – MissingNo., Mew, and the Urban Legends of the First Games
06:18 – Burger King's Deadly Pokéball Toys (1999)
08:18 – Banned Episodes & Anime Censorship Explained
09:59 – The Jynx Controversy & Ash's Blackface Incident
11:05 – The Pokémon Manga's Dark Secret
11:47 – Trading Card Bans, Swa
title: The Dark Side of Pokémon: 30 Years of Controversies You Never Knew About

author: IGN
description:
Watch a Magic: The Gathering expert react to your MTG questions! How would you explain the Magic TCG to someone who knows almost nothing about it? Well, we got PleasantKenobi, a Magic: The Gathering master, to answer a mix of Novice, Adept, and Expert level questions. So, how would you explain the Universes Beyond controversy? Are Magic proxies illegal or legal? What's the deal with the Power 9, and why does the reserve list even exist? That, and more, is answered here!

If you're new, and want to learn how to play Magic: The Gathering, this video might just have some of the answers you're looking for!

PleasantKenobi is a Magic: The Gathering content creator, with a focus on passionate and informed MTG videos for newcomers and veterans alike. You can watch his videos here: https://www.youtube.com/@PleasantKenobi/featured
title: Magic: The Gathering Expert Answers Your Novice, Adept, and Expert Questions

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Hallow Blade announcement trailer for this upcoming dark fantasy first person action-adventure game from developer Xekvera. Assume the role of a wanderer who forms a fateful, unbreakable bond with the Hallow Blade, an ancient, possessed sword that hungers for revenge - and souls. Focused on strategic, fast-paced first-person combat and deep exploration, you are tasked with overcoming the wrath of a cursed kingdom and its denizens. Hunt powerful foes and feed their souls to your weapon, as it evolves, unlocking new forms and abilities necessary in your journey to destroy the kingdom’s curse. Hallow Blade will be available on PC.

title: Hallow Blade - Official Announcement Trailer | Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase 2026
